The role provides independent risk oversight and challenge, supports compliance with regulatory requirements and approved risk appetite, and drives appropriate risk mitigation and escalation across the organization Responsibilities: 1. Operational Risk Framework Management Accountable for the implementation, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the Enterprise Operational Risk Management Framework, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and Geidea's risk strategy. 2. Risk Assessment and Risk Register Oversight Accountable for overseeing enterprise-wide operational risk assessments, RCSA activities, and maintenance of the Operational Risk Register to ensure material risks are identified, assessed, monitored, and escalated appropriately. 3. Operational Risk Governance and Reporting Accountable for providing independent challenge and reporting on operational risk exposures, emerging risks, risk appetite breaches, and control deficiencies to senior management, Operational Risk Committee, and Board Risk Committee. 4. Operational Loss and Incident Management Accountable for the oversight of operational incidents, loss events, near misses, and control failures, ensuring root cause analysis, corrective actions, and lessons learned are effectively implemented and monitored. 5. 23b03b00a1028574.description: نبذة عن مهندس ميكانيكي في شركة بنان البيوت تبحث شركة بنان البيوت للمقاولات العامة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الميكانيكية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان تنفيذ المشاريع الميكانيكية بكفاءة عالية، من خلال إعداد التصاميم التفصيلية، وتطوير خطط التركيب والتشغيل، ومتابعة برامج الصيانة. كما يشمل الدور مسؤولية إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة لضمان توثيق سير العمل وتقدم المشاريع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، مثل المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة تنفيذها. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة بنان البيوت للمقاولات العامة في مكة المكرمة. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للمهندسين تطوير مهاراتهم والمساهمة في مشاريع متنوعة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال المقاولات العامة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

23ceb6c7ace7af53.description: About the Role Ejada is seeking a Data Governance & Catalog Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on implementing, configuring, and supporting enterprise Data Governance, Metadata Management, and Data Catalog solutions, primarily utilizing Informatica technologies. The position is central to enabling effective data discovery, metadata governance, business glossary management, data lineage, and data quality initiatives, while also supporting enterprise data governance programs and regulatory compliance requirements. Key Responsibilities Implement, configure, and maintain Informatica Enterprise Data Catalog (EDC), Axon Data Governance, and Cloud Data Governance & Catalog (CDGC) solutions. Support enterprise metadata management, business glossary management, data lineage, and data catalog initiatives. Configure and onboard data assets, data sources, databases, applications, and enterprise platforms into the data catalog environment. Develop and maintain metadata scanning, harvesting, classification, and lineage processes. Configure and manage business glossaries, data dictionaries, taxonomy structures, and governance workflows. Support metadata governance, stewardship, and data ownership processes across business and technology functions. Implement and maintain end-to-end data lineage and impact analysis capabilities. Collaborate with business stakeholders, data stewards, data owners, and technical teams to improve governance adoption and metadata quality. Support Data Governance, Data Quality, and Data Management programs through Informatica platform capabilities. Configure data quality monitoring and governance integrations where required. Support user training, platform adoption activities, and governance enablement initiatives. Develop governance reports, dashboards, and adoption metrics. Troubleshoot platform issues and provide operational support for metadata and governance solutions. Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance policies, standards, and regulatory requirements. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline. Informatica Data Governance, Data Catalog, or IDMC certifications. Additional certifications in Data Governance, DAMA, CDMP, or Enterprise Data Management are preferred. Experience Required A minimum of 5 years of experience in Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Catalog, or Enterprise Data Management. Hands-on experience implementing and supporting Informatica EDC, Axon, and CDGC solutions. Experience with metadata management, business glossary management, data lineage, and governance processes. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to critical data governance initiatives within a professional setting.

23f16f48368488a7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجد افق الاستثمار عن أخصائي إدارة خدمات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتحليل الخدمات، وإعداد الخطط التطويرية والتشغيلية، وتحسين الفاعلية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الخدمات لتحديد المتطلبات وإعداد الخطط التطويرية والتشغيلية. تحسين فاعلية الخدمات الحالية والمستقبلية لضمان أعلى معايير الجودة والكفاءة. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات وعرضها على المعنيين ومناقشتها. تقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة بناءً على التحليلات، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. دراسة التجارب والممارسات العالمية في إدارة الخدمات وتقييم جدوى الاستفادة منها. رفع التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات في مجال إدارة الخدمات. تحليل العمليات والإجراءات التفصيلية للخدمات لضمان تكاملها وسلامة مساراتها التدفقية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات التطوير الإداري باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة ومواكبة المستجدات في المجال. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إدارة الخدمات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم توصيات واضحة ومبنية على الحقائق. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم الفعال للخدمات. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية والإدارية في مجال إدارة الخدمات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة، ويوفر فرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحسين وتطوير الخدمات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

23fdde80baf36cb5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث محل خرازة للتجارة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان رضا العملاء من خلال تقديم خدمة مبيعات ممتازة، والمساهمة في نمو إيرادات الشركة. الهدف من الوظيفة يتمثل الهدف الرئيسي لهذا الدور في الحفاظ على المتجر في حالة جيدة، وتقديم خدمة مبيعات عالية الجودة للعملاء، والمساعدة في عمليات البيع لزيادة نمو الشركة وإيراداتها بشكل فعال. المهام والمسؤوليات استقبال العملاء وتوجيههم داخل أقسام المعرض. تقديم معلومات دقيقة عن المنتجات المعروضة، بما في ذلك الأسعار والميزات وخدمات ما بعد البيع. التجاوب مع استفسارات العملاء المتعلقة بالخدمات والمنتجات المعروضة. إجراء مقارنات بين أسعار وميزات المنتجات المختلفة لتشجيع العملاء على الشراء. اتباع الإجراءات الصحيحة لإدارة صناديق البيع. الالتزام بسياسات وتعليمات المنشأة. المشاركة في عمليات الجرد الدوري والسنوي للمخزون. العمل على زيادة مبيعات الفرع. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. مهارات تواصل قوية ولباقة في التعامل مع العملاء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

23b89e0be373ca63.description: المسمى الوظيفي: مدير مطعم الإدارة: التشغيل الهدف من الوظيفة : إدارة وتشغيل المطعم يوميًا بما يضمن تحقيق أهداف المبيعات، جودة الخدمة، ضبط التكاليف، ورفع كفاءة الفريق، مع الالتزام بمعايير التشغيل المعتمدة وتحقيق تجربة متميزة للعملاء . المهام والمسؤوليات : * إدارة العمليات اليومية للمطعم والإشراف على سير العمل . * تحقيق مستهدفات المبيعات والربحية ومؤشرات الأداء التشغيلية . * الإشراف على فريق العمل وتوزيع المهام ومتابعة الانضباط والإنتاجية . * ضمان تطبيق معايير الجودة وخدمة العملاء وسلامة الغذاء . * متابعة المخزون والطلبات والتوريد وتقليل الهدر . * ضبط التكاليف التشغيلية ومراقبة المصروفات اليومية . * متابعة تطبيق الريسبي المعتمد وضمان الالتزام بالمقادير والجودة . * تنفيذ معايير هندسة المنيو والتأكد من التركيز على الأصناف المستهدفة بيعيًا . * متابعة جودة المنتج وسرعة الخدمة داخل المطعم . * إعداد الجداول التشغيلية وتنظيم القوى العاملة حسب الاحتياج . * معالجة شكاوى العملاء وحل المشكلات التشغيلية بشكل فوري . * تدريب الموظفين الجدد وتطوير أداء الفريق . * إجراء الجرد الدوري ومتابعة العهد والأصول التشغيلية . * رفع التقارير التشغيلية الدورية للإدارة المباشرة . * التأكد من الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات والاشتراطات الصحية المعتمدة . المؤهلات والخبرات : * خبرة في إدارة وتشغيل المطاعم لا تقل عن 3-6 سنوات . * معرفة بإدارة التكاليف، المخزون، التشغيل، والجودة . * القدرة على قيادة الفريق وإدارة ضغط العمل . * مهارات في المتابعة، التنظيم، وحل المشكلات . * يفضل خبرة في أنظمة نقاط البيع والتقارير التشغيلية .

23e9315423b1bd9d.description: Dhil Al-Nakhil Contracting Company announces a job vacancy for the position of Electrical Technician to work on the following project: Project Name: Maintenance of Municipality Nurseries and Greenhouses Project in Jeddah Governorate. Maintain electrical wiring, connections, and components. Perform necessary inspections and ensure the safety of electrical systems. Adhere to technical drawings, specifications, and safety procedures. Requirements: Diploma or technical qualification in Electrical specialization. Practical experience in electrical work and maintenance. Knowledge of using electrical measurement and testing tools. Adherence to safety and quality requirements at the worksite. A valid professional classification from the Saudi Council of Engineers is required.

23bb93080a7bc99e.description: We are looking for an experienced Invoice Matching Team Lead to join our warehouse-based operations team , leading daily invoice matching, reconciliation, exception resolution, and team coordination activities within a fast-paced warehouse environment. Responsibilities: Lead daily 3-way matching of supplier invoices against POs, GRNs, returns, and supporting documents. Verify quantities, prices, item references, receiving status, and documentation before closing transactions. Investigate and resolve invoice, quantity, receiving, return, duplicate, and documentation discrepancies . Coordinate with Receiving, Stock Control, Finance, Procurement/Commercial, and suppliers to resolve outstanding issues. Prioritize high-value, aged, and business-critical unmatched transactions and ensure timely closure. Allocate daily tasks and monitor team productivity, accuracy, workload, and completion . Review complex cases and coach team members on investigation and reconciliation procedures. Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation, and audit-ready reconciliations . Monitor key KPIs including matching completion, exception rate, ageing, accuracy, and closure time . Identify recurring issues and support process improvement, standardization, and automation initiatives . Escalate material, unusual, or unsupported discrepancies to the relevant supervisor. 3–5 years of relevant experience in invoice matching, reconciliation, Accounts Payable, inventory, warehouse administration, or supply chain operations. Previous team lead or supervisory experience is preferred. Strong knowledge of 3-way matching, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, returns, and invoice documentation . Good understanding of warehouse and inventory transaction flows and discrepancy investigation. Experience using ERP/WMS systems and advanced Excel for reconciliation and reporting. Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and documentation control. Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, follow-up, and problem-solving skills . Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field . CPIM, inventory management, AP, or supply chain certifications are an advantage.

23829aaf99657300.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a FLS Technician to join its team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time position involves performing daily maintenance tasks related to fire and life safety systems within the hotel environment. The role focuses on ensuring the operational integrity and compliance of all safety equipment to provide a secure experience for guests and staff. Role Overview The FLS Technician is responsible for the inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting of fire and life safety systems. This position is integral to the hotel's safety protocols, ensuring all systems are functional and ready for any potential incident. The role requires a proactive approach to safety and a commitment to maintaining high standards of operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular inspections of fire alarm systems, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, fire pumps, and other fire and life safety equipment. Perform scheduled testing, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting of fire and life safety systems to ensure continuous operation and compliance. Respond promptly to reported fire and life safety system faults, assisting in resolution or escalating issues as necessary. Regularly inspect designated hotel areas to identify potential fire and life safety hazards and report any issues requiring attention. Accurately record inspections, tests, maintenance activities, and system faults in accordance with hotel procedures. 23af53611e6bc1fd.description: About Mohammad Al-Habib Real Estate Investment Company Mohammad Al-Habib Real Estate Investment Company, established in 1972, is a privately-held, family-owned firm specializing in real estate investments, developments, and master plans. The company focuses on scouting land for urban projects, managing construction details with contractors, and designing commercial and residential communities. This full-time position involves direct execution and delivery of mechanical works on a landmark high-rise towers development. The role requires a skilled and experienced mechanical engineer to take full responsibility as the Main Contractor's/Developer's site engineer. Key Responsibilities Act as the Main Contractor's/Developer's site engineer, responsible for direct execution, resourcing, and delivery of mechanical works. Supervise and execute the installation of HVAC, plumbing, fire-fighting, and chilled water systems according to approved drawings. Coordinate mechanical works with civil, electrical, and architectural site activities. Verify shop drawing implementation and BIM coordination compliance on site. Conduct and record formal site work inspections at each stage of mechanical installation (pipe routing, pressure testing, insulation, equipment installation) prior to sign-off and progression. Manage direct labor crews and/or subcontractors performing mechanical works, and verify progress and quality. Prepare and verify quantity take-offs and measurement of executed mechanical works for interim payment certificates and variation/change order evaluation. Coordinate directly with the Technical Team and design consultants on RFIs and site queries affecting mechanical works. Supervise and mentor Junior Mechanical Engineers assigned to respective work fronts. Monitor testing, balancing, and commissioning of mechanical systems. Ensure compliance with mechanical codes, Civil Defense fire-fighting requirements, and the project's technical standards. Maintain inspection and test records for mechanical installations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering roles, specifically in site execution. Demonstrated experience in supervising and executing HVAC, plumbing, fire-fighting, and chilled water systems. Proficiency in verifying shop drawing implementation and BIM coordination. Experience in managing labor crews and/or subcontractors. Ability to prepare quantity take-offs and evaluate payment certificates and change orders. Strong understanding of mechanical codes, Civil Defense requirements, and project technical standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on a high-rise towers development project. The role involves working directly on-site and coordinating with various teams and consultants. Application Process Candidates who are goal-oriented, persevering, self-motivated, and ambitious are encouraged to apply. The company values individuals who are people-oriented and committed to achieving results.

2300475e5c991649.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking a Tinting Machine Operator to join our team in the Central Region, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves operating and maintaining tinting machinery to ensure accurate color mixing and dispensing for customer orders. Key Responsibilities Operate the tinting machine to mix required colors accurately. Cross-check dispensed colors with the master collection before handover to customers to ensure correctness. Maintain the machine by ensuring required colorant levels and performing periodic, proper maintenance. Clean the colorant dispense nozzle daily and keep the machine neat and clean. Inform the service team about calibration schedules and maintain the machine in good, calibrated condition. Monitor and record colorant levels and batch numbers on a daily basis. Mention batch numbers and expiration dates on each tinted color can. Keep the tinting machine database updated in coordination with the color lab. Maintain service records and dispense history. Execute all function-related activities using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform any other duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. 23511e7ff6140c82.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معمار للتطوير والاستثمار عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريق عملها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد وتطوير التصاميم المعمارية الداخلية والخارجية، وإنتاج الرسومات التنفيذية اللازمة لتنفيذ المشاريع، مع الالتزام بالمعايير الفنية المطلوبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير التصاميم المعمارية الداخلية والخارجية للمشاريع. إنتاج الرسومات والمخططات التنفيذية والتفصيلية اللازمة للمشاريع. تطوير المخططات والتصاميم بما يتوافق مع متطلبات المشروع المحددة. استخدام برامج التصميم والرسم الهندسي المتخصصة لإعداد المخططات والرسومات. إعداد وتحديث الرسومات باستخدام برامج مثل AutoCAD وRevit. التنسيق والتعاون الفعال مع أعضاء فريق العمل والجهات ذات العلاقة بالمشاريع. المساهمة في مراجعة وتطوير التصاميم والمخططات بناءً على احتياجات المشروع. الالتزام بالمعايير الفنية ومتطلبات الجودة في جميع مراحل إعداد الرسومات والتصاميم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على إعداد وتطوير التصاميم المعمارية الداخلية والخارجية. الالتزام بالمعايير والمتطلبات الفنية في جميع الأعمال. المهارات التقنية إتقان استخدام برامج التصميم والرسم الهندسي. خبرة في استخدام برامج AutoCAD وRevit. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق شركة معمار للتطوير والاستثمار في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التعاون والتنسيق المستمر مع الزملاء والجهات المعنية لضمان سير المشاريع بكفاءة. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب. للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة معمار للتطوير والاستثمار، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

23c16b39dade03b4.description: About the Role Trend Micro is seeking an experienced Resident Technical Account Manager (Resident TAM) to serve as a trusted technical representative for strategic customers. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and involves end-to-end ownership of customer technical engagements, ensuring maximum value from cybersecurity investments. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for customers, managing technical issues and engaging Trend Micro resources for resolution. Understand customer IT, cybersecurity, and business objectives, aligning Trend Micro solutions to meet these requirements. Serve as the technical project manager for the implementation, maintenance, upgrades, and adoption of Trend Micro solutions. Manage escalations for critical, severe, and urgent incidents, coordinating with Trend Micro Support, Engineering, and Product Management teams. Function as the single point of contact (SPOC) for critical technical escalations across all deployed Trend Micro solutions. Conduct regular technical reviews with customers and the local Trend Micro team, covering incident reports, solution health, product roadmaps, custom reports, and open issues. Hold regular meetings with customer IT and security operations teams to review open issues, challenges, and support requirements. 239e97f44e78df33.description: Job Description The Turbine & Precision Equipment Rigger is responsible for executing highly critical, heavy, and precision lifting operations during power plant turbine outages and industrial maintenance shutdowns. This role demands exceptional technical expertise to safely handle multi-million dollar rotating equipment, gas/steam turbine components, and delicate machinery within tightly restricted spaces. The successful candidate must strictly adhere to engineered lifting plans, maintain zero-compromise safety standards, and display flawless precision under fast-paced outage timelines. Key Responsibilities Rigging Execution: Safely attach, lift, guide, and position heavy turbine components and associated mechanical equipment in strict compliance with approved, engineered lifting plans . Pre-Lift Assessment: Thoroughly review critical technical parameters prior to every lift, including total load weight, exact center of gravity , designated lifting points, travel path clearances, and final landing arrangements. Equipment Management: Select, calculate, and inspect specialized rigging hardware such as synthetic/wire-rope slings, shackles, spreader beams , chain blocks, and specialized lifting accessories. Compliance & Safety Verification: Audit all lifting tackle before use to verify valid identification tags, current inspection status, and Working Load Limits (WLL) . Precision Maneuvering: Expertly guide immense structural loads through highly restricted areas and congested plant environments utilizing controlled mechanical methods and precise signaling. Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years of proven experience as an industrial rigger, with a strong preference for candidates who have completed major turbine outages, power plant shutdowns, or heavy mechanical maintenance . Technical Skills: Comprehensive knowledge of rigging mathematics, center-of-gravity calculations, crane signals, and rigging hardware capacities. Certifications: Valid third-party rigging certifications (such as TUV, Bureau Veritas, Aramco, or equivalents ) are highly preferred. Physical Capability: Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and handle the physical demands of 12-hour shifts typical during emergency or scheduled outages. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork orientation, high attention to detail, and a strict commitment to safety protocols.

232d1ed5cbe5ecf1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مصنع قطاعات عن فني معادن للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ المهام الفنية لدعم الأبحاث في علم المعادن والمساهمة في تطوير التطبيقات الصناعية والعملية. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل معدات وآلات التصنيع والإنتاج وفقاً لإجراءات العمل المعتمدة. تنفيذ أعمال قص وتجهيز وتجميع قطاعات الألمنيوم والمعادن حسب المواصفات الفنية. استخدام أدوات القياس والفحص لضمان دقة الأبعاد وجودة المنتج. تنفيذ أعمال التغليف والتعبئة للمنتجات النهائية وتجهيزها للتخزين أو الشحن. المساهمة في عمليات الإنتاج وتقديم الدعم للفريق الفني عند الحاجة. فحص المنتجات واكتشاف العيوب وإبلاغ المسؤول المباشر بأي ملاحظات. المحافظة على سلامة المعدات والأدوات المستخدمة والإبلاغ عن الأعطال. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير الجودة والسلامة والصحة المهنية داخل المصنع. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل. تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى ذات صلة بطبيعة العمل يكلف بها من قبل المسؤول المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشغيل المعدات والآلات الصناعية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والجودة المهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية في التعامل مع المعادن والألمنيوم. دقة في استخدام أدوات القياس والفحص. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المعادن في بيئة مصنع بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق فني متخصص. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

2357bbca40249589.description: About Applied Intuition Applied Intuition, Inc. is a Silicon Valley company founded in 2017, valued at $15 billion, that develops digital infrastructure for physical AI. The company supports the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining, and agriculture industries through tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy solutions. Applied Intuition's solutions are trusted by eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, Applied Intuition maintains offices globally, including Washington, *, London, Stuttgart, Munich, Stockholm, Bangalore, Seoul, and Tokyo. This is a full-time, in-office position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Employees are expected to primarily work from the Applied Intuition office five days a week, with flexibility for occasional remote work or adjusted schedules to accommodate personal commitments. The Role: Vehicle Operations Lead Middle East Applied Intuition is seeking a Vehicle Operations Lead for the Middle East region, specifically in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves owning vehicle operations for the SDS platform across the region, beginning with the on-road commercial trucking program and expanding to additional vehicle platforms and customer programs as the company scales. The Lead will manage end-to-end operational execution for SDS on-road programs, from fleet and site readiness to daily operations, validation, and continuous feedback to engineering, ensuring SDS-enabled vehicles operate safely, compliantly, and efficiently on public roads. This position offers a perspective on the development of cutting-edge autonomy technology while collaborating with major industry players globally. Key Responsibilities Lead regional vehicle operations, overseeing operational execution for SDS on-road programs, starting with commercial trucking and expanding to other vehicle platforms. Manage fleet and site readiness, daily execution, and operational performance across vehicle programs. Drive regional growth strategy, including the ramp plan for scaling operations across local programs. Develop operational playbooks covering safety, on-road execution, incident response, and escalation, applicable across various vehicle types. Collaborate with engineering, product, safety, legal, and OEM/fleet partners to align program milestones with safe and efficient execution. Implement safety protocols and best practices to meet regulatory standards in public-road environments. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of experience, with a proven track record in leading on-road commercial vehicle, autonomy, or complex fleet operations. Experience establishing and scaling multiple operational programs or vehicle lines. Demonstrated ownership of safety processes and incident response for public-road operations. Comfortable operating in hands-on, real-world environments with commercial vehicles. Experience partnering directly with OEMs, regulators, or fleet customers to achieve operational outcomes. Experience managing multi-site or international operations, considering local regulations and infrastructure constraints. Preferred Qualifications Background at a truck OEM or commercial vehicle manufacturer (*, Daimler Trucks, Volvo Trucks, PACCAR, Isuzu, Toyota, Ford Pro). Experience with ADAS or on-road autonomy validation across various vehicle types. Familiarity with Tier-1 supplier relationships (*, Bosch, Continental, ZF, Aptiv). Knowledge of KSA/regional regulatory and infrastructure requirements for commercial vehicle operations. Compensation and Benefits Compensation for eligible roles at Applied Intuition includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Benefits are subject to change and may vary based on the jurisdiction of employment. The actual base salary offered will be influenced by factors such as experience, credentials, educational attainment, skill level, and interview performance.

230296a75e46966d.description: About the Role SAPT is seeking a Receiving & Data Entry Specialist to join its team in Al Qassim, specifically in Buraydah. This full-time, onsite role is critical for ensuring accurate and efficient receiving of goods and precise data entry within a supermarket or hypermarket environment, supporting warehouse and inventory operations for FMCG and grocery products. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Receive incoming goods from suppliers and distributors in accordance with company policies and procedures. Verify received quantities against purchase orders, invoices, and delivery documents. Inspect the condition, packaging, barcodes, specifications, and expiry dates of products. Identify and report shortages, excess products, damaged, or non-conforming items to the direct supervisor. Accurately prepare and process Goods Received Note (GRN) documents. Enter receiving and product data correctly into the company's system. Handle daily data entry tasks and maintain accurate electronic and paper records. Utilize Microsoft Excel for data entry, reconciliation, and report preparation. Ensure supplier invoices and delivery documents are reviewed and properly documented. Coordinate with purchasing, warehouse, inventory, accounting, and operations teams regarding any receiving discrepancies. Ensure compliance with FIFO / FEFO procedures based on product type. Follow all approved receiving policies and procedures. Organize and maintain all receiving documents, invoices, and records. Contribute to improving inventory accuracy, minimizing receiving errors, and reducing operational losses. Immediately report any significant anomalies or irregularities in receiving operations to supervision or management. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of one year of experience receiving goods in a supermarket or hypermarket within Saudi Arabia. Experience in receiving FMCG, food, and consumer goods products. Strong skills in reviewing invoices and quantities. Hands-on experience with GRN or goods receiving systems. Proficiency in computer use and data entry. Practical proficiency with Microsoft Excel. Ability to read and write in both Arabic and English. High school diploma as a minimum qualification. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, integrity, and the ability to work under pressure and long hours. Knowledge of supplier invoices, purchase orders, delivery documents, barcodes, quantities, and product specifications. Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with suppliers and internal departments. Preferred Qualifications University degree or higher education qualification. Previous experience specifically handling large volumes of FMCG products. Knowledge of inventory procedures and stock management in retail or supermarket environments. Familiarity with document organization and archiving processes. Experience in FIFO / FEFO application in inventory management systems. Benefits Competitive salary and benefits package. On-the-job training and opportunities for career advancement. Stability and growth within a leading retail and FMCG environment. Collaborative and professional workplace culture. Employee discounts on store products. Supportive management and team environment.

23bd9f32f736dfee.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a dedicated and experienced Golf Agronomy Foreman to join our team, contributing to the management and maintenance of our world-class golf facilities. This role is crucial in ensuring the health, quality, and playability of the golf course turf, green spaces, and surrounding landscapes. As the Golf Agronomy Foreman, you will supervise and coordinate the daily activities of the agronomy team, ensuring that agronomic practices meet the highest standards of quality and sustainability. You will work closely with golf course managers and agronomy specialists to implement effective turf management and maintenance programs. Key Responsibilities Supervise and manage agronomy staff in the daily maintenance of golf course turf, including mowing, irrigation, fertilization, pest control, and soil management. Implement turf management programs that optimize turf health and ensure excellent playing conditions. Monitor turf health and soil conditions, recommending and applying corrective measures as needed. Coordinate the scheduling of maintenance activities to minimize disruption to golf course operations. Ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations in all agronomy activities. Maintain inventory of agronomy supplies and equipment, ordering materials as needed. Train and mentor agronomy staff, promoting best practices and continuous improvement. Collaborate with management to develop seasonal plans and budgets for agronomy operations. Stay updated on the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in golf course agronomy and turf management. Diploma or degree in Agronomy, Horticulture, Turf Management, or a related field. Minimum of 4-6 years of experience in golf course agronomy or turf management, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Strong knowledge of turfgrass species, soil science, pest control, irrigation systems, and fertility management. Hands-on experience with turf maintenance equipment and tools. Excellent leadership and team management skills. Ability to work in a physically demanding environment. Good communication and organizational skills. Familiarity with environmental regulations and sustainable agronomy practices. Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays as needed.

23f045da3c197510.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بيت الإبصار الطبية عن فني بصريات طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في القطيف، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، ويشمل مسؤوليات متعددة تتعلق بتجهيز وصيانة البصريات الطبية وتقديم الدعم للمرضى. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى فني البصريات الطبية مسؤولية دراسة طلبات ووصفات تصنيع البصريات الطبية، وتجهيز العدسات الطبية والعدسات اللاصقة، بالإضافة إلى تدريب الأفراد على استخدامها والعناية بها. كما يشمل الدور صيانة البصريات القديمة وإعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالعمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طلبات تصنيع البصريات الطبية وتحديد المواصفات المطلوبة. أخذ قياسات وجه المريض الأساسية اللازمة لتجهيز النظارة الطبية أو العدسات اللاصقة وتفصيلها. اختيار زجاج العدسات الطبية بالتشاور مع المريض أو بناءً على توصية الطبيب المعالج وتجهيزها. اختيار الإطارات وتركيب العدسات عليها ومعايرتها لضمان الدقة. تدريب المرضى على الاستخدام الصحيح للنظارات الطبية أو العدسات اللاصقة وكيفية حمايتها والعناية بها. إعادة تركيب العدسات للنظارات الطبية القديمة وصيانة إطاراتها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال البصريات الطبية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق وصفات تصنيع البصريات الطبية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتعامل مع المرضى. بيئة العمل يعمل فني البصريات الطبية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة بيت الإبصار الطبية في مدينة القطيف بالمنطقة الشرقية، ويساهم في تقديم خدمات الرعاية البصرية للمرضى. تقديم الطلبات الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر قنوات التوظيف المتاحة.

The group operates across five continents, with the Middle East entity providing IT and technology services in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Jordan. Astek supports clients in sectors including public and government, healthcare, transportation, banking, retail, airlines, and tourism. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and will focus on systems used across facility management and energy efficiency operations. Key Responsibilities Configure, manage, and maintain CAFM/IWMS platforms to support facility management and O&M operations. Maintain accurate facility asset records, maintenance schedules, work orders, and related data. Validate and update asset and facility information within CAFM systems. Generate reports, dashboards, and KPIs to support operational and management decision-making. Coordinate with project teams, facility managers, and operations teams to ensure accurate asset inventories and maintenance plans. Provide technical support and user training for CAFM system users across multiple sites. Support integration of CAFM systems with ERP, BMS, GIS, BIM, or other enterprise platforms. Assist with facility management documentation, asset registers, and project lifecycle records. The ideal candidate will demonstrate attention to data accuracy and the ability to collaborate effectively across facility management, technical, and operational teams. 23131a734912897c.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs transport solutions worldwide, focusing on social inclusion and access to essential services. For 65 years, SYSTRA has partnered with cities and regions to develop, improve, and modernize infrastructure and transport systems across their entire project lifecycles, from design to maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions to innovate future mobility. Project Manager (Metro) Role Overview SYSTRA is seeking an experienced Project Manager (Metro) to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex metro programs in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires extensive rail and transit expertise combined with rigorous governance and client-facing leadership. The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring the successful execution of metro projects, from initial planning through to handover into operation. Key Responsibilities Manage the full lifecycle delivery for metro assets and systems, including planning, design, procurement, construction, systems installation, testing, commissioning, trial operations, and handover. Establish integrated master schedules, stage gates, and KPIs aligned with client objectives, ensuring performance across safety, scope, schedule, cost, and quality. Act as the primary interface with client organizations, transport authorities, utilities, city planners, designers, contractors, operators, and independent checking engineers. Lead governance forums, approvals, and executive reporting to drive timely decisions and alignment among civil, systems, and operational stakeholders. Oversee multidisciplinary scopes including civil works (tunnels, viaducts, stations, depots), rail systems (trackwork, power/traction, SCADA, signaling, train control—CBTC preferred, telecoms), rolling stock interfaces, PSDs, and OCS. Manage critical interfaces between design-and-build packages, systems integrators, and third parties to maintain integration integrity. Shape procurement strategies for multi-package metro delivery (civil works, MEP, systems, rolling stock, systems integration, O&M). Administer contracts, change control, claims, and risk allocation, coordinating with legal and commercial teams for compliance and value optimization. Implement comprehensive risk management, configuration control, and change governance, enforcing QA/QC processes and independent safety assessment coordination. Lead HSE excellence across contractors, aligning with international rail safety practices, and drive systems assurance, RAMS, EMC/EMI, cybersecurity, and safety certification readiness. Plan and manage integrated testing and commissioning (IOTC), trial running, reliability growth, and safety certification. Coordinate with operators on O&M strategy, staffing, training, maintenance regimes, spares, and asset information requirements to ensure a smooth handover into passenger service. Build and lead a matrixed team covering PMO, planning and scheduling, cost, risk, engineering, assurance, and site supervision, fostering collaboration and continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in project management within the metro or rail industry. Demonstrated leadership and influence across client, authority, and contractor ecosystems. Strong systems integration mindset with disciplined interface management capabilities. Commercial acumen in complex, multi-contract environments. Ability to provide clear, concise executive reporting and conduct adept stakeholder negotiation. Proven resilient problem-solving skills in high-velocity program conditions. Uncompromising commitment to safety, quality, and passenger-centric outcomes. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. SYSTRA is an equal opportunities company, and this position is open to all qualified applicants.

239101eecde42af0.job_title: Staff Product Manager - Shipping and Fulfillment
239101eecde42af0.description: About the Role Over 100,000 merchants run their businesses on Salla, and every order they win ends the same way: something physical has to reach a customer. Shipping is where the platform stops being software. This role owns the shipping stack end to end and the economics underneath it: courier integrations, routing, cash-on-delivery reconciliation, exceptions, and partner performance, plus how far past last-mile delivery we go into inventory placement, warehousing, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, and returns. You lead a dedicated engineering squad as its one accountable product owner, and you own what a shipment costs and what the platform keeps on it. Few product roles let you own a merchant experience and its unit economics at the same time. This one does. You will drive impact across four major domains: Shipping Products (routing, label issuance, cash on delivery, tracking, driver-facing tools) Partner Integrations (provider onboarding, interface quality, status mapping, reconciliation, platform stability) Fulfillment Beyond Last Mile (inventory placement, warehousing and third-party orchestration, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, returns) Shipping Economics (carrier mix, rate card design, cost per successful delivery, what the platform charges and what it keeps) Responsibilities: Own the strategy and roadmap for shipping and fulfillment, prioritized on merchant retention and contribution per shipment, not feature count. Decide how each order is routed and priced: which provider carries it, at what service level, at what cost, and what the merchant pays. Raise delivery reliability where it is measurable: first-attempt success, service-level accuracy, exception rate, return to origin, and cash-on-delivery reconciliation. Build the integration layer that makes onboarding a new provider fast and keeps it stable once live: status mapping, retries, fallbacks, monitoring. Extend the product past last-mile delivery, choosing capabilities on merchant retention impact rather than on integration ease. Decide which shipping capability is free and which is paid, and defend where the line sits. Own the metrics with the data team, and move volume between providers when the performance data says to. Proven ownership of a shipping, fulfillment, or order-management product on a platform serving many businesses at once, with the numbers you moved: delivery success rate, service-level accuracy, exception rate, cash-on-delivery accuracy, or cost per shipment. Commercial fluency in shipment economics: you have built, priced, or renegotiated a rate card, and can explain how zone, weight, service level, cash on delivery, surcharges, and failed deliveries move cost per parcel. Depth past last-mile delivery in at least two of: inventory placement, warehousing or third-party fulfillment orchestration, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, reverse logistics, cross-border. Technical grounding in integrations: interfaces, webhooks, status mapping, retries, reconciliation. You can explain how a courier integration actually breaks and what made yours stable long term. Experience as the single product owner for a dedicated engineering squad, working across operations, commercial, and support rather than around them. Strongly preferred: you have built product on top of a partner network, where the company sold partner capacity and built its own capability alongside it. Seven or more years in product management. Full professional fluency in Arabic and English is required, and GCC logistics context is preferred over theoretical knowledge. Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia.

234fcfe6034d01f8.description: The Warehouse Chemist is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and efficient management of chemicals and dangerous goods within warehouse operations. The Warehouse Chemist provides technical expertise to support warehouse operations, minimize risks, maintain regulatory compliance, and promote best practices in chemical management. The position also supports audits, emergency response activities, and continuous improvement initiatives related to hazardous materials management. Key Responsibilities Receive, inspect, identify, classify, and verify chemicals and dangerous goods to ensure compliance with purchase specifications and regulatory requirements. Ensure the safe storage, segregation, handling, and transportation of chemicals in accordance with applicable safety standards and regulations. Conduct routine inspections of chemical storage areas and recommend corrective actions to address safety, environmental, and compliance risks. Monitor chemical inventory, shelf life, storage conditions, and maintain accurate records, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and regulatory documentation. Assess chemical compatibility and perform risk assessments to minimize hazards and support safe warehouse operations. Coordinate the safe disposal of expired, obsolete, or hazardous chemicals in compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements. Experience conducting chemical risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. 23038b2dc8ce6798.description: Eram Talent is searching for a Finance & Revenue Cycle Management Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This role is essential in ensuring the effective financial management of the organization's revenue cycle processes. The specialist will be responsible for analyzing financial data, optimizing revenue streams, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations and policies. This role is crucial in ensuring the accurate, timely, and transparent validation of invoices, quotations, and insurance claims across all providers and insurers. The position requires close coordination with the operator, insurers, and internal finance teams to ensure compliance, reduce rejections, and improve financial sustainability. Responsibilities Financial Oversight: Review and validate all invoices submitted by the operator for accuracy and compliance. Review and validate quotations for services and ensure alignment with agreed contractual terms. Collaborate with Finance and KAUST leadership on budget adherence, forecasting, and expenditure control. Reporting & Analysis: Provide regular financial and insurance claim performance reports to senior leadership. Track KPIs related to financial and revenue cycle performance. identify risks and opportunities for revenue optimization. Work closely with the Head of Health, Operations Manager, and Finance department to ensure alignment of financial and operational objectives. Support audits and ensure compliance with internal and external financial regulations. Bachelor’s degree (required) in Finance or Accounting (preferred). Master’s degree in Finance (preferred). Professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA) are an advantage. Minimum 6 years of experience, with at least 3 years in a lead role. Proven experience in the healthcare sector finance, insurance, or revenue cycle management. Strong background in financial analysis, budgeting, and reporting. Hands-on experience with insurance claim processes, validation, and reconciliation. Demonstrated experience in preparing, managing, and monitoring budgets within a healthcare environment.
